content: # Naumburg, cathedral city full of medieval magic. The medieval cathedral city of Naumburg was the crown jewel. For centuries, the city has enchanted visitors with a mix of history, culture and architecture. Naumburg is particularly known for its magnificent cathedral, which is on the UNESCO World Heritage list. From medieval streets to the historic tram, Naumburg is a journey through time. * Naumburg, a city with a rich history. The history of Naumburg begins in the 11th century. It later even became the seat of the bishopric of Naumburg-Zeitz, which contributed to the rapid growth and prosperity of the city. After World War II, Naumburg became part of East Germany and experienced a period of recovery and reconstruction, during which much of its historical heritage was preserved.
